task: Issue #727: exclude Trivy ConfigAuditReports of superseded Deployment ReplicaSet revisions and verify Deployment ownership in Portal Compliance.

events.summary: Explicit owner decision (2026-11-19): grant ClusterRole narwhal-portal read-only get/list on apps/replicasets and filter only superseded Deployment revisions in the portal. No watch, write verbs, or wildcard rules; no new dependencies; no live cluster mutation or push.

After Deployment rollouts, trivy-operator retains ConfigAuditReports for old superseded ReplicaSets (e.g. velero, trivy-operator, keycloak-operator). portal/src/lib/compliance.ts previously listed only configauditreports without inspecting ReplicaSets, counting stale revisions as live findings; filtering on spec.replicas === 0 alone or caching ReplicaSets separately from reports risked hiding standalone ReplicaSets, scaled-to-zero Deployments, terminating pods, or post-rollback active revisions; compliance-accepted.ts also collapsed any SafeEncodeString hash suffix without checking metadata.ownerReferences.

Added get/list on apps/replicasets to ClusterRole narwhal-portal (narwhal-portal-k8s.yaml). In portal/src/lib/compliance.ts, fetched /apis/apps/v1/replicasets in the same request path as configauditreports (no separate ReplicaSet cache; only combined filtered report results are cached) and dropped a ReplicaSet report only when all hold: (a) Deployment ownerReference, (b) spec.replicas == 0 and status.replicas == 0, and (c) another ReplicaSet owned by the same Deployment in the same namespace has a strictly higher numeric deployment.kubernetes.io/revision annotation — keeping standalone ReplicaSets, scaled-to-zero current revisions, terminating revisions, unknown fields, and fetch/missing failures with one warning. Passed metadata.ownerReferences Deployment names into normalizeWorkloadName/matchConfigAuditException in compliance-accepted.ts. Updated docs/common/compliance-hardening.md, lessons-log.md, changelogs, and pinned the entire ClusterRole narwhal-portal rule set in R378.
